jobs.description: Urban Walker Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability) Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors) About Walkr Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work. We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day. The role We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. jobs.title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
jobs.description: Über tonies: tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. Du als Teil von tonies: Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben. Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen: IT-Strategie & Architektur Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit. Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce). Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX. IT-Governance & Sicherheit Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal). Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.). Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans. Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende. Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen. Was wir uns von dir wünschen: Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich). Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards. Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“. Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365). Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen. Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus). Warum tonies? Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies ® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt. Wir freuen uns auf deine digitale Bewerbung! Ketsia Dinzala People & Culture Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: CRM & Subscription Manager*in (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir sind Fabio und Luis, die Gründer von Hunderunde. Wir haben Hunderunde gestartet, weil wir überzeugt sind: Hunde verdienen natürliche Ernährung, die wirklich hilft. Unsere pflanzenbasierten Toppings unterstützen Verdauung, Haut & Fell und das allgemeine Wohlbefinden von Hunden, tierärztlich mitentwickelt und mit echtem Anspruch an Wirksamkeit. Für uns ist das keine reine Business-Idee: Ein Teil dessen, was wir verdienen, geht an ein Straßenhund-Rettungsprojekt in Rumänien, Tierschutz gehört für uns genauso zur Marke wie das Produkt selbst. Aufgaben Deine Aufgabe: Diese Reise so zu gestalten, dass mehr Menschen bleiben, statt nach der ersten Bestellung wieder zu verschwinden. Klaviyo als dein Zuhause: Du baust, testest und optimierst unsere E-Mail-Flows (Post-Purchase, Win-Back, Wirkungsfenster-Check-ins bei Woche 2 & 6, Kündigungs-Flows) und Kampagnen. Segmentierung ist für dich kein Buzzword, sondern Alltag. WhatsApp-Marketing: Du entwickelst unseren WhatsApp-Kanal als zweiten Lifecycle-Kanal weiter – von Onboarding-Sequenzen bis zu Sparplan-Reminder und Winback. Sparplan-Steuerung: Du bist verantwortlich dafür, dass unser Abo wächst und weniger Menschen kündigen. Du kennst die technischen Grenzen von ReCharge (z. B. bei Rabatt-Mechaniken für Bestandskunden) und findest trotzdem smarte Lösungen – Pause-Angebote statt Kündigung, Win-Back-Flows für reversible Absprünge, Intervall-Anpassungen. Datengetriebenes Arbeiten: Du liest unsere Kundendaten (Shopify, ReCharge, Klaviyo, Umfragen) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab – nicht nur Reports, sondern Taten. A/B-Testing & Optimierung: Betreffzeilen, Sendezeitpunkte, Flow-Logik – du testest kontinuierlich und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, nicht Bauchgefühl. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern, unserem Content-/Copy-Bereich und unserer Kundenservice-Kollegin zusammen, um Kommunikation konsistent gegenüber unseren Kunden zu halten. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: 2–3+ Jahre Erfahrung als CRM Manager, Retention Manager oder E-Mail Marketing Manager – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke Praxiserfahrung mit Klaviyo (oder vergleichbarem) auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau: Flows, Segmentierung, Deliverability Erfahrung mit Subscription-/Abo-Modellen im E-Commerce (Kein Muss, aber klares Plus) Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing oder die Bereitschaft, dich da schnell reinzufuchsen Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kohorten, Churn-Raten und Flow-Performance und ziehst daraus die richtigen Schlüsse Sehr gutes Deutsch (Wort und Schrift) – unsere Kommunikation ist warm, persönlich, auf Augenhöhe mit unseren Kundinnen Nice-to-haves: Erfahrung im Pet-, Food-Supplement- oder Wellness-Bereich Shopify-Kenntnisse Erste Erfahrung mit Compliance-Anforderungen bei gesundheitsbezogenen Claims (wir arbeiten mit tierärztlich begleiteten Studien und einem strikten Wording-Regelwerk) Gespür für Copy – du musst keine Texter:in sein, aber ein gutes Gefühl für Ton und Sprache hilft enorm Benefits Was wir bieten Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Hebel im Unternehmen – kein Zuarbeiten, sondern echte Ownership über CRM & Subcription Model Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, kein Konzern-Prozess Ein Produkt, hinter dem du stehen kannst: pflanzenbasierte Toppings, tierärztlich mitentwickelt, mit echtem Tierschutz-Engagement Ein Team, das schnell wächst und in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbare Wirkung hat Klingt nach dir? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen, warum du zu uns passt. Wir freuen uns auf dich. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization. Our customers map reality, with its levers and constraints, into a model, and we run large-scale combinatorial optimization over the critical decisions in their value chain. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people. Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models. Your mission Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job. Most optimization software fails in the same place. Not in the solver, but in the gap between what a company actually does and what the model assumes. Somebody has to sit with the people who plan today, understand how they really decide, and turn that into something a machine can compute. That is this role, and you do it hands on. You take the customer's planning problem apart, you build the model yourself, in code, on their data, and you stay with it until their management trusts the result enough to act on it. Then you bring back the part that should stop being project work and become product. Most of this happens at your desk in Cologne, with days at the customer's site when the decisive conversations happen. You are the shortest path between our product and reality. What does not survive at a customer does not work. We will not sugarcoat it: the data arrives messy, the first model is rarely the right one, and some weeks a customer deadline sets the priority. What you'll own The customer's decision problem. Sit with the people who plan today, understand capacities, costs, lead times and the constraints nobody wrote down, and turn it into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. Inventory, scheduling, supply shortages, order prioritization: the decisions that determine whether a plant stays competitive. The customer's model, end to end. You own it from the first conversation to the version that runs in production. Our math and OR team owns the engine and the solver core underneath; you own what is built on top of it for this customer. The data it runs on. ERP and Excel exports, inconsistent and incomplete. You get them into shape yourself and notice when numbers cannot be right before the customer does. The result, all the way to trust. Not a demo. A model that is used, questioned, corrected and used again. The feedback loop into the product. You see the same problem at the second and third customer before anyone else does. You make the call at the customer, and you argue the case for what belongs in the platform. Your work, from the first line of code to a model the customer runs. Nobody hands you a ticket and waits. How we work Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your work end to end: you build it, you ship it to production yourself, you run it. Feedback runs both ways and continuously, in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals, communicate proactively, and flag early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job. We review each other's work, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room. Requirements You have built quantitative models for real operations problems and taken them into production, not into a slide deck. Optimization, simulation, or a combination of both. You have done this more than once, end to end, and at least one of those models still runs without you in the room. You still write the production code yourself, today. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers. The role The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation. The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role. This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold. Responsibilities Purchase orders and supplier ledger Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed. Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger. Prepare payment runs for approval. Nothing leaves the business without a bill, a PO and a sign-off. Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made. Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate. Reconciliation and coding Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories. Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick. Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one. Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end. Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero. Receipts and VAT recovery Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description: Sales Development Representative Edinburgh Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams. This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline. This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention. What you’ll do Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders. Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets. Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs. Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market. Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity. What we’re looking for SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required). A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent. Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging. High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales. High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities. Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management. How we work We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default. This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems. There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome. This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy. Why Wordsmith We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts. The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand. If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. jobs.description: Who are we? Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We're a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting, from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds. At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth. If you're ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong. We welcome applications from candidates who are genuinely energised by the challenge of building a brand and a growth engine at scale, and who have the track record to prove it. We look forward to reviewing your application. The Team This role sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, overseeing marketing teams and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, trading, data, and the executive team to grow the business. Prediction markets and exchange products are having a moment, and the team's job is to capture that energy: building the Smarkets brand and the brands within our group, and making every pound of the marketing budget work harder than the last. About the Role: As our VP Commercial & Marketing, you'll be responsible for every marketing lever we have: brand, acquisition, and retention, across multiple markets, including UK and US. Your team will be accountable for how the world discovers Smarkets and the brands within our group, why they choose us over anyone else, and why they stay. We're looking for a senior leader who has scaled a direct-to-consumer brand before and understands the pitfalls and opportunities. We need someone who will set the strategy for marketing and roll up their sleeves to execute. If you want to direct from a distance, this isn't the role for you. If you want to own the number, build up the team, and be measured on the growth you deliver, read on. You will own the marketing budget, and we'll expect you to make every pound work harder than the last. Success looks like ROI and disciplined scaling; failure looks like vanity spend that fails to deliver the unit economics. This role reports to the COO and sits at the heart of our commercial strategy. What you will do: Own the Strategy: Own a multi-jurisdiction marketing strategy end-to-end, accountable for design and execution across brand, acquisition, and retention. Shape Go-to-Market: Help develop the commercial strategy for go-to-market projects and our core brands. Deliver ROI: Accountable for effective ROI on the annual marketing budget. Build the Team: Mentor and develop a high-performing marketing team, raising the bar on talent and standards. Scale Performance Marketing: Build the processes to scale performance marketing across paid channels, relentlessly improving CAC, ROAS, and payback. Sharpen the Brand: Sharpen and grow the Smarkets brand: our positioning, our voice, and how we show up in a crowded market. Drive Retention: Develop the retention and lifecycle strategy, turning first-time users into loyal, high-value traders through CRM and lifecycle marketing. Own the Metrics: Define the metrics that matter, hold the team to them, and make decisions grounded in data. Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap. Role Requirements: Proven Brand Builder: A senior marketing leader with a proven track record of scaling a brand. D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly. Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions. Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a busine

Database proficiency — you're comfortable with SQL (Postgres or similar) and have some exposure to NoSQL stores. A structured approach to problem-solving — you think clearly about system design and trade-offs. Strong collaboration skills — you communicate well across engineering, product, and design. jobs.title: Chief of Staff / Business Ops
jobs.description: Global supply chains move 80% of world trade and almost none of it accounts for its climate impact. Searoutes builds the data infrastructure that lets freight forwarders, shippers, and carriers measure and cut their CO2 footprint. We're a ~20-person SaaS team headquartered between Marseille and Nice, backed by Breakthrough (a US venture platform), and growing fast with enterprise logistics clients across the globe. We're looking for a  Chief of Staff  to become the CEO's right hand and the operational engine of the company as we scale, someone who thrives on turning strategic priorities into flawless execution, and who wants a front-row seat (and real influence) on how a European climate-tech scale-up is built. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Direct line to the top.  You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and sit in the room for every major decision, no layers, no filters. Real scope, real ownership.  This isn't a coordination-only or admin-only role. You'll own the board rhythm, shape internal reporting, and run special projects end-to-end. A bridge between two worlds.  You'll be the connective tissue between a lean European startup and a US shareholder, a rare vantage point most operators only get years into their career. Impact you can see.  With ~20 people, your work doesn't get lost in a hierarchy. What you fix, ships. What you build, gets used. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Board & shareholder rhythm  Own the full cadence with our shareholders:  board decks, pre-reads, action tracking, and follow-through, so nothing slips between meetings Leadership operating system  Run the agenda, follow-ups, and accountability loop for leadership meetings. The person who makes sure decisions turn into action, not just notes. Reporting & analytics  Build and maintain pipeline dashboards (HubSpot), KPI tracking, and management/investor reporting that leadership actually relies on. CEO partnership  Support the CEO on communications, meeting prep, and represent them in operational forums when needed. Special projects  Lead cross-functional initiative:  process improvements, tool rollouts, scaling projects with real autonomy to design and execute. Requirements 3–5 years in business operations, strategy consulting, or a Chief of Staff–type role, SaaS or logistics/supply chain experience is a strong plus A builder's mindset: organized, detail-obsessed, and allergic to dropped balls Comfort with data: HubSpot, spreadsheets, dashboards, and slide decks are your natural habitat Fluent French and English, written and spoken Genuine ease working across cultures, you'll be in daily contact with US-based teams A proactive streak: you spot what's needed before anyone has to ask Startup energy,  you're energized by ambiguity, not slowed by it NICE TO HAVE Experience working with US shareholders or inside a subsidiary structure Familiarity with Notion, PandaDoc, Basecamp, or HubSpot A genuine interest in sustainability, logistics, or the maritime industry Experience helping a company professionalize through a scaling phase Benefits A high-impact seat at the leadership table, from day one Exposure to both European startup culture and US corporate governance A fast-paced, no-BS environment; your work matters immediately, not eventually Competitive fixed salary + performance bonus Mutuelle, and standard French benefits (Syntec collective agreement) Two company-wide offsites a year A mission worth showing up for: helping decarbonize global trade Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
jobs.description: About Cartesia Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do. We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences. We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI. Overview We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French. This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language. This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support. About the Engagement You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include: Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel. Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects. Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric. Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations. Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language. Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases. Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators. Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time. Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators. Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes. Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team. Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes. Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Commitment Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected. Requirements Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France. Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance. Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines. Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English. Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators. Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates. Self-

jobs.title: Head of Partner Marketing France
jobs.description: Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont les gens commandent et apprécient leurs repas. Chez Deliveroo, notre équipe Brand & Experience crée des expériences engageantes qui renforcent le lien entre notre marque et nos clients, partenaires et livreurs. À propos du poste Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Partner Marketing France pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing France, basée à Paris. Rattaché(e) à la Head of Marketing France, vous piloterez l'une des trois équipes Marketing du marché français et managerez une équipe de 6 personnes. Votre mission : faire de nos partenaires (Restaurants, Grocery, Retail…) l'une des principales raisons pour lesquelles les consommateurs choisissent notre plateforme. À la croisée du Marketing et du Commercial, vous définirez la stratégie Partner Marketing du marché français, imaginerez des campagnes et des partenariats créatifs qui renforcent notre marque et recrutent de nouveaux clients, tout en accompagnant la croissance de nos partenaires et les priorités business de l'entreprise. Ce que vous ferez: Définir la stratégie Partner Marketing pour nos différents segments (Restaurants, Grocery, Retail, National Accounts, Global Key Accounts…), en cohérence avec les priorités Global et les enjeux du marché français. Imaginer des campagnes et des activations créatives qui mettent en valeur nos partenaires et créent de la préférence de marque : partenariats exclusifs, lancements, expériences, collaborations ou opérations spéciales capables de recruter de nouveaux clients et de générer de l'engagement. Construire des plans marketing sur mesure pour nos partenaires stratégiques, en conciliant objectifs commerciaux, ambitions marketing et expérience client. Être le partenaire stratégique des équipes commerciales, en comprenant les enjeux business, en participant à la construction de propositions de valeur et en transformant les opportunités commerciales en plateformes marketing différenciantes. Fédérer les équipes (Sales, Promotions, Brand & Media, Integrated Marketing, Creative, CRM, Analytics et Global) afin de construire des plans marketing intégrés et de faire émerger les meilleures idées collectives. Manager et développer une équipe de 6 personnes, en apportant vision, coaching, structure et exigence d'exécution, afin de faire monter l'équipe en compétences et en autonomie. Piloter la performance, grâce à une forte culture de la donnée, en mesurant l'impact des actions, en priorisant les initiatives et en assurant une exécution irréprochable. Le profil recherché Vous êtes un(e) leader marketing capable de combiner vision stratégique, créativité et sens du business. Vous apportez notamment : 6/7+ ans d'expérience en Marketing, avec une expérience significative dans la définition de stratégies marketing à fort impact. Une solide compréhension des enjeux commerciaux et de la manière dont le marketing peut accélérer la croissance d'un business et créer de la valeur pour des partenaires. Une forte sensibilité créative et une excellente culture de marque, avec la capacité d'imaginer des campagnes qui marquent les esprits autant qu'elles délivrent des résultats. Une capacité reconnue à influencer et fédérer des équipes dans un environnement matriciel, en créant de l'alignement autour d'une vision commune. Une expérience réussie en management et dans le développement de talents. Une approche à la fois stratégique, structurée et très orientée exécution, avec une forte culture de la donnée. Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! jobs.description: Agent d’Exploitation Polyvalent (Editions) Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission visant à transformer la façon dont les gens achètent et mangent, où l'impact, l'innovation et la croissance motivent tout ce que nous faisons. Notre équipe Commerciale est au cœur de la marketplace de Deliveroo : elle façonne la manière dont nous servons les restaurants, les commerçants et les nouveaux secteurs à travers le monde. De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Si vous aimez les environnements commerciaux dynamiques et que vous souhaitez influencer l'avenir d'une marque mondiale, cette équipe est faite pour vous. Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDD- 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen . Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions . Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle. Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien : Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires. Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises. Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi. Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité. Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins. Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir Essentiel : Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément. Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients. Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome. Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP. Souhaité : Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant. Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée). Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à : 🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs. 🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travai

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media - France to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. Keep Deliveroo connected to culture , monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description: Why Deliveroo Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Customer Care team supports Deliveroo’s customers, riders, and restaurant partners—delivering thoughtful, efficient, and empathetic service at every interaction. Whether solving live issues, building proactive support experiences, or driving continuous improvement through data and insights, we are champions of service excellence across our entire marketplace. If you care deeply about people and love making things better—this is the place for you. As an Operations Manager - based in the Paris office on a hybrid basis - you’ll be finding solutions to some of our biggest challenges to deliver a seamless customer experience in the French market, thus directly contributing to one of the key pillars of Deliveroo’s strategy within the Operations function. We are looking for a fully-autonomous critical thinker who is able to own a market level area, instrumental in identifying growth & quality objectives, build plans with strong modelling skills, and lead their delivery. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations. You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. jobs.title: Immobilienmakler (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Vermietung | Werkstudent oder Teilzeit
jobs.description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag. Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht. Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund. Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner. Ein Makler aus dem Team begleitet dich, gibt dir Rückmeldung und übernimmt, wenn ein Fall komplizierter wird. Fragen zu stellen ist bei uns kein Zeichen von Schwäche, sondern Teil des Jobs. Wir entwickeln unsere Makler selbst. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, hat nach dem Studium eine Perspektive. Du arbeitest mit Software, die es sonst nicht gibt. Unser eigenes System lpeOS bildet Prozesse ab, für die andere Unternehmen noch mit Excel-Listen und Papierordnern arbeiten. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du organisierst die Vermarktung einer Einheit. Fototermin mit unseren Fotografen abstimmen und begleiten, Exposé erstellen, Inserat veröffentlichen und aktuell halten. Beim Exposé unterstützt dich unser Marketing. Du kümmerst dich um die Interessenten. Anfragen sichten und vorqualifizieren, Termine koordinieren, Besichtigungen durchführen und nachfassen. Auch dann, wenn auf ein Objekt vierzig Anfragen kommen. Du bereitest die Mieterauswahl vor. Unterlagen auf Vollständigkeit prüfen, Bonitätsnachweise sichten und deine Einschätzung zu den Bewerbern abgeben. Die finale Entscheidung trefft ihr gemeinsam. Du unterstützt bei Abnahmen und Übergaben: Protokolle vorbereiten, Zählerstände erfassen, Mängel dokumentieren, Schlüssel übergeben. Du hältst die Daten sauber. Jeder Kontakt, jeder Termin, jeder Status im System. Das klingt unspektakulär und ist die Grundlage dafür, dass bei uns nichts verloren geht. Du arbeitest den Maklern zu. Termine vorbereiten, Objektunterlagen zusammenstellen, Korrespondenz übernehmen, bei Interessenten und Dienstleistern nachfassen. Vieles davon lernst du dabei nebenbei — weil du siehst, wie ein erfahrener Makler einen Fall aufbaut. Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben. Stammdaten pflegen, Unterlagen digitalisieren und ablegen, Prozesse dokumentieren. Wie viel das ist, hängt von der Auslastung ab — planbar besprechen wir das jede Woche. Was du mitbringen solltest Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu. Eine Besichtigung mit acht fremden Leuten zu führen, muss dir liegen. Perfekt sein musst du dabei am Anfang nicht. Du hast ein Gespür für Menschen — oder willst es entwickeln. Bei der Mieterauswahl zählt nicht nur die Bonität, und genau dieses Urteil lernst du bei uns. Du bist gut organisiert. Mehrere Objekte, Termine und Fristen parallel: Wer hier den Überblick verliert, verliert auch den guten Mieter. Du arbeitest zuverlässig. Interessenten stehen sonst vor verschlossener Tür, und das kostet uns beim Eigentümer mehr als jeder Fehler im Exposé. Du fragst nach, statt zu raten — bei Kunden genauso wie im Team. Du bist eingeschrieben oder suchst eine Teilzeitstelle. Die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig, kaufmännisches oder immobilienwirtschaftliches Interesse hilft. Du lernst Software schnell und denkst digital. Vorerfahrung in der Immobilienbranche brauchst du nicht. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei. Was wir dir bieten Einarbeitung. Du läufst mit, bekommst deine Aufgaben schrittweise und arbeitest ab dem ersten Tag mit jemandem zusammen, den du alles fragen kannst. Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen. Du machst keine Ablage und keine Kaffeeküche, sondern Arbeit, die im Lebenslauf etwas bedeutet und die du im nächsten Bewerbungsgespräch erklären kannst. Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, bekommt eine Zukunft und nicht nur ein Zeugnis. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und du Für unser fast 20-köpfiges Analytics & Data Platforms - Department sind wir auf der Suche nach einem/r Data Engineer, der/die Spaß daran hat, die Digitalisierung innerhalb der ARD und ihren Landesrundfunkanstalten voranzutreiben. Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Projektteams bist du verantwortlich für Schlüsselprojekte: von der Implementierung des ARD-weiten Data Meshs über die effiziente Verarbeitung von Clickstreams und die Bereitstellung von Data Marts für BI-Dashboards. Wir setzen stark auf Eigeninitiative und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Kennst du eine Technologie noch nicht so gut, dann lernst du sie durch unsere Unterstützung im Rahmen des Training-on-the-job. Da du mal mehr, mal weniger direkte pub.tech Kolleg*innen um dich herum hast, uns das persönliche Miteinander aber sehr wichtig ist, pflegen wir regelmäßigen Kontakt über direkte Einzelgespräche, regelmäßige Fachteammeetings und einem pub.tech-Weekly, in dem sich die ganze Firma über Neuigkeiten austauscht und wir Transparenz zwischen allen Bereichen schaffen. Außerdem wichtig für dich zu wissen: wir nehmen sehr viel Rücksicht darauf, Privates wie Familie und Kinder mit der Arbeit vereinbaren zu können. Wenn es dich unter diesen Bedingungen reizt, die digitale Zukunft des öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunks mitzugestalten, dann ist dieser Job genau richtig für dich! Folgende Aufgaben erwarten dich bei uns Sorge dafür, dass wir die richtigen Dinge messen: Gemeinsam mit Produkt, Redaktion und Engineering entwickelst Du Tracking- und Messkonzepte , definierst relevante Kennzahlen und stellst sicher, dass die benötigten Daten vollständig , verständlich und verlässlich zur Verfügung stehen. Dabei bewegst Du Dich sicher an der Schnittstelle zur technischen Datenerhebung und arbeitest auch selbst mit SQL und strukturierten Datensätzen . Mach Daten für Teams zugänglich und nutzbar : Du entwickelst Dashboards, Reports und Analysen , mit denen Teams Erfolge transparent messen, Entwicklungen früh erkennen und unsere Zielgruppen respektvoll und differenziert verstehen können. Als analytischer Sparringspartner berätst Du Redaktions- und Produktteams dabei, aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten. Mach aus Nutzungsmustern echte Erkenntnisse: Du analysierst, wie Menschen die digitalen Inhalte und Produkte der ARD nutzen, und übersetzt komplexe Analytics- und Trackingdaten in verständliche und handlungsleitende Erkenntnisse . Damit hilfst Du Produkt- und Redaktionsteams, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und digitale Angebote kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Das bringst du mit Idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit quantitativem oder analytischem Schwerpunkt, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Analyse und Aufbereitung großer Datenmengen sowie im Umgang mit digitalen Nutzungs- und Trackingdaten Gute Kenntnisse in SQL (BigQuery) sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) und dbt. Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Reports und Dashboards mit BI- und Visualisierungstools insbesondere Erfahrung mit Power BI. Verständnis für Trackingkonzepte, KPIs und Datenqualität sowie Interesse an der Schnittstelle zu Produkt und Engineering Starke analytische Fähigkeiten zur Lösung komplexer Datenprobleme sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit in einem internationalen Umfeld ( Englisch und Deutsch mindestens C1 ) Das bieten wir Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit 31 Tagen Urlaub Ein attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehalt Jede Menge Spielraum für eigene Ideen und berufliche Weiterentwicklung Diversität und Chancengleichheit Teilnahme an Weiterbildungen je nach deinen persönlichen Interessen und Zielen Arbeit mit talentierten, kreativen und multikulturellen Teams Einen Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von München Flexible Arbeitszeiten Remotework innerhalb Deutschlands und in einigen europäischen Länder

At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><h3>POSITION OVERVIEW</h3> <p>Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. jobs.title: Senior Manager - Incentives
jobs.description: This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. We collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Regional Operations, Rider Marketing and the Retention team to secure and retain a high-quality fleet. We are seeking a Senior Manager to own three of the core engines behind our rider supply strategy: incentives, performance tracking, and target setting with scope to own wider areas of responsibility as these solutions are productionised. You will have overall accountability of our rider referral program from strategy to execution. You’ll partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring incentive spend across the rider lifecycle is efficient, well-targeted, and joined up. As part of this, you’ll design the governance frameworks needed to ensure all incentives across referrals, retention, resurrection and activation are operating efficiently and tests are designed robustly. You will also own performance tracking of rider hours end-to-end, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives, and working with Data Science to attribute causality to that work – giving senior stakeholders an accurate, defensible read on how our supply investments are performing. Finally, you will own our rider applicant target-setting model which is used to determine our rider acquisition forecasts vs top-down targets, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams. Improvements here will ensure we’re able to plan for longer time horizons with greater degrees of accuracy as well as scenario planning with our Rider Marketing team to drive efficiencies in cost per applicant. What we’re looking for Analytical Rigor : You are highly comfortable building and defending forecasting, target-setting, and attribution models, and can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Ownership & Follow-Through : You take full accountability for the incentives and reporting you own, proactively flagging risks to plan and driving fixes end-to-end. Cross-Functional Collaboration : You work effectively across Data Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to align on shared goals and targets. Stakeholder Communication : You can distil complex performance and target-setting narratives into clear, credible updates for senior stakeholders. What you'll be doing Referral & Reactivation Incentives : Own the end-to-end strategy, performance, and budget for rider referral and reactivation incentive programmes, continuously testing and iterating to improve efficiency. Retention Incentive Partnership : Partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring a joined-up approach to incentive spend across the rider lifecycle. Rider Hours Performance Tracking : Own tracking of rider hours performance, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives. Causal Attribution : Partner with Data Science to attribute causality to individual initiatives’ contribution to rider hours, building a robust and defensible measurement framework. Senior Stakeholder Reporting : Ensure rider hours performance and initiative impact are reported accurately and clearly to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence. Weekly Applicant Target Setting : Own the weekly rider applicant target-setting process, ensuring targets reflect the latest view of demand, funnel performance, and onboarding capacity. Annual Planning : Lead applicant target setting within the annual planning cycle, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams to work back from onboard targets to applicant targets. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Subscription Value Prop & New Benefits
jobs.description: About the team The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members. About the role We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution - this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck. Typical problems you'll solve: What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each? How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity? How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it? Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next? How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work? What you'll be doing Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution. Cross-functional delivery - partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them. Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline - evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next. Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention. Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably. Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context. Communicate to senior stakeholders - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership. Requirements 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations - ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech. Commercial acumen : strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics. Analytical rigor : comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call - you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what." Bias for action and ownership : able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend. Cross-functional influence : track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment. Excellent written and verbal communication - able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership. jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Financial Services
jobs.description: Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you! TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution. That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success. TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required. The main focus of the role is to utilise your existing knowledge and experience within the Financial Services sector to develop new business relationships and new accounts via a direct sales approach. Key position responsibilities: Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.) Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices Manage and control pricing and contractual issues Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international Essential skills required: Commit to a high level of integrity and service Deliver quality work Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations Owning your performance and taking responsibility Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems Essential experience required: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience Minimum 3 years successful sales experience Superior written and spoken communication skills in the local language Familiarity and ability to communicate value

jobs.title: Staff Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field. As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve. This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will:   Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be. Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten. Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review. Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team. Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly. Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
jobs.description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The Opportunity 9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com . But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag. These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey. The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer). You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions. This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it. What You'll Do Product Strategy & Execution Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub). Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broad

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description: Finance Manager Hybrid (UK-based) | Full-Time Flexibility on how often you come into the office, as long as you're able to travel to the London office when required. About Us Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers. We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems. The Role We're looking for a Finance Manager to own the operational management of our finance function — accurate, timely management accounts, statutory accounts oversight, and the processes and controls that keep our finances reliable as we scale. You'll run month-end close, own balance sheet reconciliation and cash flow, lead the team responsible for AR/AP, payroll, VAT, and HMRC processes, and bring the analytical rigour that helps us make good financial decisions as we grow. You'll also manage external relationships (auditors, solicitors, bankers), support external investment and funding activity, and run accounts across multiple business entities, including regulated entities in different geographies. Key Responsibilities Month-end close and reporting — own the close process end-to-end and prepare the monthly management accounts pack (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), presenting to leadership as required Balance sheet, cash flow, and VAT — reconciliations, cash flow forecasting, and end-to-end ownership of the quarterly group VAT return Statutory accounts and audit — independently manage the year-end audit and contribute to annual statutory accounts under FRS 102 Team management — manage the AR & AP team, setting objectives and developing capability Multi-entity accounting — accurate inter-company accounting across parent and subsidiary entities Systems and process improvement — maintain and improve finance systems, identifying opportunities for efficiency gains Strategic input — financial modelling and risk analysis to support decision-making, plus external investor/funding support What We Need Qualification: ACA, ACCA, or CIMA qualified. Experience: Several years' experience in a small business finance function, with direct experience owning month-end and year-end close processes Experience managing a junior team member or members Experience running multiple business entities — parent and subsidiaries, including regulated entities across different geographies Independent ownership of the year-end audit process Systems: Xero or similar is desirable but not essential where the candidate is system-adaptable. Our Hiring Process We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages. Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition — Video call, ~30-45 minutes Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation — Video call, ~60 minutes Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CEO — Video call, ~60 minutes Feedback typically comes within a few business days between stages. How to Apply Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system. Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d) - EMEA
jobs.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? Your role Own day-to-day client relationships across a portfolio of KAM accounts, building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across research, insights, strategy, and increasingly at VP and Director level. Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business priorities, use cases, and success metrics — and proactively connect Statista’s platform to the problems they are trying to solve. Maintain an up-to-date account health picture for every account in your portfolio — usage trends, stakeholder changes, risk signals, and expansion indicators. Be the client’s primary point of contact for onboarding, adoption, value realisation, and renewal — and the person they call when they want to get more from the platform. Your profile 2–4 years of B2B Customer Success experience, with a track record of managing and growing a portfolio of accounts in a subscription-based model. Proven ability to drive platform adoption and demonstrate value to clients — turning usage data and client outcomes into compelling renewal and expansion conversations. Commercial instinct — you understand that CS is a revenue function and you approach client conversations with that mindset. Strong relationship-building skills — you can build trust with operational contacts and progressively develop access to more senior stakeholders. Proactive and organised — you manage a portfolio with structure, maintain accurate records, and never let a renewal sneak up on you. Comfortable with data — you can analyse usage reports, health scores, and account trends to identify risk and opportunity.
